fields.summary_ko.0: Walmart (WMT) gained +22.5% for the month through November 2, significantly outperforming S&P 500's -2.3%, with current P/E of 46x on 12-month EPS (vs. S&P 500 median of 22.8x, reflecting premium valuation).
fields.summary_ko.1: 12-month operating income growth of 11.4% (as of July 31, 2026) outpaces revenue growth of 6.2%, with 4.4% operating margin below S&P 500 median of 18.6%.
fields.summary_ko.2: Membership, advertising, and marketplace contribute approximately 50% of profit growth, with global advertising revenue up 38% and store sales down low single-digit on a comparable basis, reflecting elevated fuel costs and weak in-store health and wellness performance.
